entities.name: Ja’afar I of Negeri Sembilan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ja’afar ibni Almarhum Tuanku Abdul Rahman was the Yang di-Pertuan Besar of Negeri Sembilan from 1967 until his death in 2008, and the tenth Yang di-Pertuan Agong, from 1994 to 1999.
